scope: Add an immutable safe-time proposal successor and exact dormant policy registration; repair one audited documentation build-skip path without changing historical contracts, actual product or live authority.
riskAnalysis: Closed single-label validity/fallback grammar, immutable prior contracts and goldens, fresh exact task/policy/source/release owner activation, serial lifecycle and canonical journal coverage. Default policy and live configuration unchanged; no generated execution or model calls. One exact nonruntime documentation path is allowlisted with both historical/current declaration hashes.

threatModel.assets: Source-bound patch integrity, historical evidence, owner/policy isolation, serial execution, honest criticism and Preview build selection.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: New immutable descriptor versus old grants/receipts; fixture data versus genuine model patch; exact documentation path versus mixed/runtime source.
threatModel.abuseCases: Unchecked Date recipe, injected code or attributes, old/cross-policy authority, parallel execution, missing report quality, wildcard skip or Production skip.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact safe grammar and preimage, fresh descriptor/policy, unchanged owner/source controller, serial/lifecycle/journal ID coverage, terminal marker, immutable historical pins and exact Preview/docs comparison.

defects.rootCause: Old task grammar required the unchecked Date formatter that failed the real invalid-time test; it could not express the required fallback.
defects.detectionGap: Prior schema/fixture admission proved allowed shape but not this timestamp behavior.
defects.regression: New grammar/adversarial checks plus real-controller five-stage offline workflow; preserve old v5 contract/guidance and40historical request hashes.
defects.historicalPrevention: Use explicit edge-case criteria and actual source tests before product adoption; never rewrite old descriptors or call a fixture an agent implementation.

defects.rootCause: Adoption-review path was absent from the exact documentation build-skip allowlist.
defects.detectionGap: Prior checkpoint assumed all nonruntime documentation paths were already audited.
defects.regression: Exact added path skips only confirmed feature Preview; wrong context, mixed source, missing history and lookalikes do not skip.
defects.historicalPrevention: Check actual allowlist membership and preserve audited old/new literal pins before documentation publication.

rollback: Revert only new successor registration/grammar and exact docs skip change via reviewed feature commit; preserve all old contracts and failure evidence. Keep paid execution off and never reuse consumed approvals.
